name: Sunlight
summary: Native Mac controls for a Tasmota smart bulb: moods, slow color compositions, warm start-up and on-device daylight automation. Your bulb's details stay in a private local file.
story: Smart-bulb apps want accounts and clouds. Sunlight talks straight to a Tasmota bulb on your Wi-Fi: twelve moods, slow compositions, a warm Edison start-up, and a daylight program that runs on the bulb itself, even with the Mac asleep.

launcher.long: Sunlight: power, brightness, colors, dedicated white, warm startup and on-device daylight automation, with private recovery backups.
